slides.title: How do you show up when nobody here knows you yet?

body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand in an even tie, one arm over and one arm under, on both sides.
Fight to get under your partner's elbows. Connect your hands anywhere from his armpits to his ankles.

items: Whoever connects first wins. The first closed-hand connection, anywhere from armpits to ankles, takes it.

body.text: SLO: Arriving for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is in half guard on his side, arms out straight. The top player is inside the half guard.

Top player: clear the bottom player's hands and get under at least one elbow, then connect your hands. Bottom player: keep your hands on the top player to deny that spot, and close your legs around his waist.

items: The top player wins by getting under one elbow and connecting his hands.
The bottom player wins by closing his legs around the top player's waist.

body.text: SLO: Controlling for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is on his back. The top player is in mount with both arms under both of the bottom player's elbows.

Top player: stay under at least one elbow the whole round. If you lose one, fight to get it back. Bottom player: get both elbows to touch your own body with nothing under them, or make the top player fall over.

items: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps at least one elbow covered.
The bottom player wins by touching both elbows to his body, or by making the top player fall.

options.feedback: That is the win condition, and nothing else scores.
